sections.text:
Component: TemperatureSensor | input: RawTemperature | output: CoolantTemperature | period_ms: 100
Component: ThermalController | input: CoolantTemperature | output: FanDuty | period_ms: 100
Component: FanDriver | input: FanDuty | output: FanSpeed | period_ms: 20

Signal: CoolantTemperature | producer: TemperatureSensor | consumer: ThermalController | unit: Celsius | min: -40 | max: 150
Signal: FanDuty | producer: ThermalController | consumer: FanDriver | unit: percent | min: 0 | max: 100
ThermalController requests 80 percent FanDuty when CoolantTemperature exceeds 95 Celsius. These are synthetic teaching thresholds.
Interface: IFan | sender: ThermalController | receiver: FanDriver | sender_unit: percent | receiver_unit: rpm

Dependency: ThermalController -> TemperatureSensor
Dependency: FanDriver -> ThermalController
Dependency: ThermalController -> MissingSensor
